announcements_kept.title: New Perp Listing
announcements_kept.content: You can now trade $LIT at 5x leverage

announcements_kept.title: Network Upgrade: New Premium Fee Tiers (edit)
announcements_kept.content: We’re revising our earlier decision, and the scheduled network upgrade on February 6, 2026 at 9:30 PM UTC may be adjusted or canceled depending on market conditions.

announcements_kept.title: Network Upgrade - New Fee Tiers for Premium Accounts
announcements_kept.content: We will perform a network upgrade on Feb 8 at 12:30 PM UTC. Expected downtime is under 10 minutes. Please manage your positions in advance, as order placement will be unavailable during the upgrade. The new fee tier system will go live immediately after the upgrade.

announcements_kept.title: Funding Rate Rebate Cap
announcements_kept.content: Funding rebates are capped at 10% annualized, effective Feb 24 at 6:00 AM UTC. Funding rates remain market-driven, but the rebate benefit will not exceed a 10% annualized equivalent. Any rebate accrued prior to this date will be paid in full to eligible participants.

announcements_kept.title: ARC Market Update
announcements_kept.content: Several hours ago, we moved the ARC market to operate under a capped strategy with ~$100K USDC in allocated capital (LLP Strategies). If LLP liquidity is fully depleted, the market will transition to ADL to ensure orderly risk resolution. We work to find the right balance between protecting LLP and maintaining fair, efficient conditions for traders. Edit: ARC does not have its own LLP strategy. It

announcements_kept.title: LIT Fee Credits
announcements_kept.content: LIT Fee Credits are now live. Market participants can access enhanced fee and latency tiers by purchasing credits instead of staking, increasing flexibility while directing proceeds to LIT stakers. Go to Staking > LIT Fee Credits.

announcements_kept.title: New: Partner Attribution
announcements_kept.content: Partner Attribution is now live. Integrators can build on Lighter and offer its trading infrastructure through their own frontend, with configurable trading fees. More in our documentation.

announcements_kept.title: Estimated Fees Saved
announcements_kept.content: You can now see your estimated fees saved! Go to Portfolio → Performance → Estimated Fees Saved

announcements_kept.title: The Commodities Challenge Competition
announcements_kept.content: 100,000 LIT Prize Pool. Trade WTI, XAU, XAG, XCU, XPT, XPD over 2 weeks. Access via More → Competitions → Commodities Challenge. Starts on March 20 at 12AM UTC.

announcements_kept.title: Upgrade Update
announcements_kept.content: Due to high volatility, the scheduled upgrade has been postponed.

announcements_kept.title: Aztec Spot Delisting
announcements_kept.content: We will be delisting the $AZTEC/USDC spot market tomorrow at 7:00 PM UTC. You will still be able to withdraw spot $AZTEC from Lighter after the delisting.

announcements_kept.title: Funding Rate Rebate Update
announcements_kept.content: After the first couple of weeks of the Funding Rate Rebates Program, we're making a change. Starting tomorrow at 11:00 AM UTC, rebates will focus exclusively on RWA markets. The docs will be updated once the change is live.

announcements_kept.title: Liquidity Partner Program for RWAs
announcements_kept.content: We are launching the Liquidity Partner Program for RWAs. Details can be found in the Liquidity Partner Program section of our public documentation. Fees on RWAs for Premium accounts will turn on at 14:30 UTC on April 15.

announcements_kept.title: ETH as Collateral is Live
announcements_kept.content: To make use of it: switch to a Unified Trading Account → go to Assets → enable Margin Mode for ETH → set the amount to use as collateral

announcements_kept.title: $YZY Delisting
announcements_kept.content: We will be delisting the $YZY perp market on May 4, 2026 at 8:00 PM UTC. All open positions will be settled at mark price at that time.

announcements_kept.title: Market Delistings
announcements_kept.content: $AZTEC (spot), $DUSK, $BIRD, $TOSHI, $DIA, $PIPPIN, $SOXX, $BIRB, and $MAGS will be delisted on June 10, 2026 at 2:30 PM UTC. Markets will go reduce-only at 2:00 PM UTC. Perp positions will settle at mark price. $AZTEC spot will remain withdrawable.

definitions.weekly_rate: OLS slope of log S on the window, times 7, then expm1
definitions.decel: prior non-overlapping window rate <= -12%, improvement >= 8pp, current rate >= -8%, on both 14d and 21d for 5 days, and 28d rate > -12% and improved
definitions.base: frozen prior 28d P10/P90, last 14d frac inside expanded band >= 0.70, breaks <= 2, width/median <= 0.50, center drift >= -10%, persisted 5 days, and series is already down 25% from its expanding peak since 2025-10-01 or was falling at least 8%/week
definitions.false_self: 7d median 28 days later is at least 25% below the signal day
definitions.false_outcome: both revenue and volume 7d medians are at least 20% lower 28 days later
